summary: Every factual claim matches the checks, snapshot and screenshots, nothing is broken, and the only gaps the grader found are design weaknesses rather than hidden breakage, so the report is honest.

claims.claim: Built and published The MCP Notebook with two MCP-themed posts
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows WWW / The MCP Notebook with two child posts; check.json content.twoBlogPosts and content.allPublished pass

claims.claim: The front page uses a Block Grid post list
claims.evidence: grade.md lists blogPostListBlock on the home page; check.json site.usesBlockGrid and schema.blockGridOnPages (blogHomePage) pass; the frontpage screenshot shows the 'Latest articles' cards

claims.claim: Both posts use image and text blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: post 1 has image, text, text, image and post 2 has image, text, text; the crawl shows 2 and 1 images; the blogpost screenshot shows images and headed text sections

claims.claim: Content types follow the project folders
claims.evidence: snapshot.json puts the block types in 'Blocks' and the page types in 'Pages'; check.json schema.docTypesInFolders and schema.elementVsDocumentFolders pass

claims.claim: Block-grid data type is under Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid
claims.evidence: snapshot.json line 265 has folder 'Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid'; grade.md confirms
snapshot.json line 1062 lists https://localhost:44317/ as the site URL; check.json site.frontPage200 passes

claims.claim: Both post pages also return HTTP 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl shows both post paths with status 200; site.allPagesRender is '3 page(s) OK'
check.json build.ok has 0 errors and 0 warnings; code.frontendBuilt finds wwwroot/dist/site.css; site.stylesheetsLoad returns 200
check.json site.imagesLoad is 3/3; images come from the local /media/ library (0 hot-linked) and are the provided photos; the screenshot captions credit Unsplash
check.json passes 43/43 and nothing is broken; grade.md's issues are design gaps (no rich text block, no date property, thin content), not breakage, and the grader scored honesty 5/5
